create.name: Robert Aceves
create.bio:
Robert Aceves is a Zen meditation teacher and coach who was born in Mexico and grew up in California, where he still lives. He came across Zen Buddhism as a nine-year-old and has kept practising for close to three decades, including a spell of training at Bukkokuji, a Zen monastery in Japan. He studied psychology and social behaviour at the University of California, Irvine, and has worked as a coach with individuals, couples and groups, using meditation, mindfulness and hypnosis alongside practical self-help tools.

He teaches mostly in Spanish, in a plain, down-to-earth style that avoids dogma and jargon and treats Zen as a way of being fully present in ordinary life rather than a retreat from it. His main offering is a ten-day online course in Spanish that introduces zazen, breathing, self-observation and the core teachings of the Buddha through short daily video lessons. He runs two YouTube channels, one in Spanish and one in English, with guided meditations, body scans and sleep meditations woven around traditional Zen stories, and shares a similar mix on Insight Timer, where he also has a ten-day Spanish course on Zen practice.

courses.title: Curso de 10 Días (10-Day Zen Course)
courses.description: A self-paced introduction to Zen Buddhism in Spanish, taught through ten short video lessons, one for each day. It covers zazen, conscious breathing and self-observation, as well as the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path. One payment gives lifetime access, with a 30-day refund guarantee.

courses.title: Introducción a la Práctica del Budismo Zen
courses.description: A ten-day course in Spanish on Insight Timer for beginners who want to start sitting in the Zen way. It moves through the basics of practice one short session at a time.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 29.9k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 38.9k (Spanish channel header next to @Robert.Medita, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 1.57k (English channel header next to @Robert.Meditates, 31 Oct 2026); no Instagram/Facebook/X/TikTok accounts found linked from his site or profiles → ~70k total → local_hero
flags: Works mainly in Spanish: his site, paid course, Insight Timer course and larger YouTube channel are all in Spanish; the English channel is small.
Presents himself on YouTube as a 'Life Coach & Meditation Specialist', but the site and course are clearly Zen teaching, so he is kept.
Much of his YouTube and Insight Timer output is titled for anxiety relief, deep sleep, addiction or 'reprogramming' while you sleep; those items are left out.
No city confirmed: Insight Timer says California and a podcast directory says Santa Ana (not checked); all teaching is online, so availability is worldwide.
His old domain raceves.com (linked from Insight Timer) refused curl with a 406; mividazen.com is used as the website.
Video picks come from the latest 30 uploads on each channel (most-viewed sort was not available); view counts are modest (under 3k).
left_out: YouTube and Insight Timer tracks titled for anxiety, insomnia ('¿No puedes dormir?'), addiction or self-healing during sleep (health claims).
No books found under his name (search turned up none).
